panels.description: Time since each metagraph last submitted a state channel snapshot to GL0. Shows (now - last_activity_epoch) in human-readable duration. High values indicate a metagraph has stopped submitting.
panels.title: Last Activity per Metagraph (time since last submission)

panels.description: Rate of SC binary submissions per metagraph. Shows how many binaries each metagraph submits over time. Use this to spot metagraphs that submit frequently vs rarely.
panels.title: Submission Rate by Metagraph

panels.description: Average submissions per hour for each metagraph over the last 24h. Indicates typical submission frequency. A metagraph submitting ~360/hr is submitting roughly every GL0 snapshot (~10s).
panels.title: Avg Submissions / Hour (last 24h)

panels.description: Total bytes submitted by each metagraph over the last 7 days. Shows which metagraphs are producing the most data volume.
panels.title: Weekly Bytes Volume by Metagraph (7d)

panels.description: Total number of SC binary submissions per metagraph over the last 7 days. Shows which metagraphs are the most active.
panels.title: Weekly Submissions Count by Metagraph (7d)

panels.description: Time since each metagraph last submitted, shown as a timeseries. Useful to see patterns of inactivity over time.
panels.title: Last Activity Timeline (seconds since last submission)

panels.description: Average bytes per submission for each metagraph. Computed as total bytes / total submissions over the last hour.
panels.title: Avg Bytes per Submission (1h window)
